vpn.name: Northstar Connect VPN
vpn.summary: Intermittent disconnects on the remote-access gateway since 9:10 a.m. Eastern Time. Failover to the secondary concentrator is in progress.
vpn.workaround: Use the Backup Gateway profile or a phone hotspot for the current meeting. Do not reinstall the client in the 30 minutes before a presentation.

email.name: Email
email.summary: Mail flow is normal. Attachments over 25 MB are still rejected.

teams.name: Teams
teams.summary: Meetings and chat are available. Media can freeze while the VPN is reconnecting.
teams.workaround: Rejoin meeting audio after the tunnel is stable.

sso.name: Single sign-on
sso.summary: Northstar sign-in is accepting normal authentication.

wifi.name: Office Wi-Fi
wifi.summary: Northstar-Corp and Northstar-Guest are broadcasting at headquarters.

catalog.name: Software catalog
catalog.summary: Endpoint installs, including Northstar Connect, are available.
